Life is full of small surprises. Leo wrote about the day in the diary. Leo hopes to visit Toronto one day. For example, the preacher spoke to a small crowd.
There are always many people at the model workbench. Last Tuesday, Leo and Max went to the chess corner. The weather was cloudy that day. His stamp collection fills three books.
Leo is reading a book about history. Leo learned a lot about history. Leo's favorite animal is the bird. The children learn craft at school.
Leo and Max had great fun there. Leo usually has bread for breakfast. Max is interested in drawing.
